title: Event envelope
description: Common wrapper for every event published on SNS. The event-specific payload goes in `data`.

event_id.description: Unique per event. Consumers use it to ignore duplicate deliveries.

event_version.description: Payload version. Bumped on breaking changes to `data`.

occurred_at.description: When the fact happened, in UTC (ISO 8601).

correlation_id.description: The application ID. Identical across every event about one application, for tracing.

data.description: Event-specific payload; see the schema for each event_type.
